# `controller` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "controller" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/controller/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Profile id, e.g. "player". |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (debug tools and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Why these values (feel targets, references), for owner review. |
| `capsule` | object | required | The player’s collision capsule (vertical, feet at the character position). |
| `capsule.radius` | number > 0 ≤ 1 | required | Capsule radius, m. |
| `capsule.height` | number > 0 ≤ 4 | required | Standing capsule height, feet to crown, m; at least 2 × radius. |
| `capsule.crouchHeight` | number > 0 ≤ 4 | required | Crouched capsule height, m; at least 2 × radius and at most height. The feet stay put, the top lowers. |
| `speeds` | object | required | Top ground speeds, m/s. Analog input scales them (half deflection = half speed). |
| `speeds.run` | number > 0 ≤ 50 | required | Top speed with the move input fully deflected, m/s. Partial input walks. |
| `speeds.sprint` | number > 0 ≤ 50 | required | Top speed while sprint is held, m/s; at least run. |
| `speeds.crouch` | number > 0 ≤ 50 | required | Top speed while crouched, m/s; at most run. |
| `accelTime` | number > 0 ≤ 2 | required | Time to reach run speed from rest on the ground, s. |
| `decelTime` | number > 0 ≤ 2 | required | Time to stop from run speed on the ground once input is released, s. |
| `airControl` | number 0–1 | required | Share of ground acceleration available in the air, 0–1; with no input the player keeps momentum. |
| `gravity` | number > 0 ≤ 100 | required | Downward acceleration, m/s². |
| `maxFallSpeed` | number > 0 ≤ 50 | required | Terminal falling speed, m/s. |
| `jumpApex` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Jump height from standing, feet to feet, m. |
| `coyoteMs` | integer 0–120 | required | After walking off a ledge a jump still works for this long, whole ms (≤ 120). |
| `jumpBufferMs` | integer 0–150 | required | A jump pressed this long before landing fires on landing, whole ms (≤ 150). |
| `stepHeight` | number 0–1 | required | Tallest step walked up without jumping, m; also how far the player snaps down to stay on stairs and ramps. Below crouchHeight. |
| `slopeLimit` | number > 0 | required | Steepest walkable slope, degrees; steeper ground is a wall the player slides off. |
| `gait` | object | — | Locomotion states and events; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_GAIT_TUNING). |
| `gait.walkFrom` | number > 0 ≤ 10 | required | Horizontal speed from which a character with move input walks (below: idle), m/s. |
| `gait.runFrom` | number > 0 ≤ 20 | required | Horizontal speed from which it runs (below: walk), m/s; above walkFrom. |
| `gait.landingMs` | integer 0–1000 | required | How long the landing state lasts after a hard landing, whole ms. |
| `gait.hardLanding` | number 0–50 | required | Impact speed from which a landing counts as hard (shows the landing state), m/s. |
| `gait.footstep` | object | required | Ground distance between footsteps per gait, m (half a stride): footstep events come from the distance travelled, not from animation. |
| `gait.footstep.walk` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Walking, m. |
| `gait.footstep.run` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Running, m. |
| `gait.footstep.sprint` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Sprinting, m. |
| `gait.footstep.crouch` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Crouching, m. |
